eval: (()=>{const rows=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#gc-device table.pol tbody tr')).map(r=>r.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' '));const g=(k)=>rows.find(x=>x.includes(k))||'';const a=g('order.overdue_grace_bd'),b=g('claim.refund_due_bd'),c=g('claim.refund_delay_rate');const perm=['order.overdue_grace_bd','claim.refund_due_bd','claim.refund_delay_rate'].map(k=>GC.Policy.permRow(k));const note=document.querySelector('#gc-device').innerText.includes('세 키가 생겼어요');const ok=a.includes('1영업일')&&a.includes('권한: 최고관리자만')&&!a.includes('법률 자문 전 초안')&&b.includes('3영업일')&&b.includes('법률 자문 전 초안')&&b.includes('법정 값 · 늘리지 않음')&&c.includes('15%')&&c.includes('법률 자문 전 초안')&&c.includes('법정 값 · 낮추지 않음')&&perm.every(x=>x==='관리자 계정 · 권한 · 정책값')&¬e;if(!ok)throw new Error('새 키 3개 '+JSON.stringify({a,b,c,perm,note}));return {a,b,c}})()

(()=>{const t=document.querySelector('#gc-device').innerText;const pv=document.querySelector('#gc-device .panel').innerText;if(!t.includes('허용 범위(0영업일 ~ 5영업일)를 벗어났어요')||!pv.includes('10/15(목) 끝')||!pv.includes('10/19(월) 끝'))throw new Error('유예 범위 '+pv.slice(0,600));return 'grace range ok'})()

(()=>{const rows=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#gc-device .mx tbody tr')).map(r=>r.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' '));const need=['NOTI_SHIP_OVERDUE','NOTI_PRODUCTION_OVERDUE','NOTI_PARTNER_SHIP_OVERDUE','NOTI_REFUND_DELAY_PAID','NOTI_INT_REFUND_DUE','NOTI_INT_REFUND_OVER'];const miss=need.filter(c=>!rows.some(r=>r.replace(/\u200b/g,'').includes(c)));if(miss.length)throw new Error('알림 행 없음 '+miss.join(','));return rows.filter(r=>/OVERDUE|REFUND_D|REFUND_O/.test(r))})()
